book.name: Saame
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI SAAME

content: Ki he Takimuʻa ʻi he Nekina, ko e Saame ʻa Tevita.

content.text: ‌ʻO kau ka kole, fanongo mai kiate au, ʻE ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku māʻoniʻoni:
naʻa ke halahalaʻi au mei he mamahi;
ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate au, pea fanongo ki heʻeku lotu.
‌ʻAe ngaahi foha ʻoe tangata, ʻe ngata ʻafē hoʻomou liliu hoku nāunau ko e meʻa fakamā?
ʻe ngata ʻafē hoʻomou ʻofa ki he meʻa vaʻinga pe, ʻo kumi ki he loi? Sila.
Ka mou ʻilo kuo vaheʻi ʻe Sihova maʻana ʻaia ʻoku angalelei:
ʻe fanongo ʻe Sihova ʻo kau ka kole kiate ia.
Mou manavahē, pea ʻoua naʻa fai angahala:
fakakaukau mo homou loto ʻi homou mohenga, pea mou fakalongo pe. Sila.
Feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi feilaulau māʻoniʻoni,
‌ʻOku pehē ʻe he tokolahi, “Ko hai te ne fakahā ha lelei kiate kitautolu?”
ʻE Sihova, ke ke hiki hake kiate kimautolu ʻae maama ʻo ho fofonga.
Kuo ke ʻai ki hoku loto ʻae fiefia lahi hake ʻi he fiefia
ʻi he kuonga naʻe tupu ʻo lahi ai ʻenau uite mo e uaine.
Te u tokoto hifo ʻi he fiemālie, ʻo mohe: he ko koe pē,
ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke pule ke u nofo lelei.
